en: A black-and-white historic street scene showing a bustling European city with ornate late 19th or early 20th century architecture. The street is lined with tall buildings featuring detailed facades and a prominent clock tower in the background. Signs for 'Café Royal' are visible, and people in period clothing are walking or working on the street. The upper part of the card bears the text 'Chemnitz. Friedrich-August-Straße.' in red.
